_about: Interactable sewer pipes (game/pipes.rs): the valve wheels a runner holds to turn, what each effect does, and the flow numbers of a pipe's water. Godot reference: game/infinite_route/infinite_route_test.gd (_request_valve, _accept_valve, _apply_valve_event), game/world/streaming/streamed_facility_view_3d.gd (VALVE_*), game/world/regions/sewer_floods.gd (RISE ... SHUT_DRAIN), sewer_route_generator.gd (FLOOD_REACH, FLOOD_MAX_CELLS). Depths are metres over the floor, times seconds, reaches walkway steps from the pipe.

prompt.shut_flood: Hold to shut off the flood

prompt.closed: Hold to raise the sluice gate
prompt.open: Hold to lower the sluice gate

_authored_note: Authored pipe floods on storeys that are not the sewer (game/hunter_pipes.rs). Each row: id (the flow id), trigger (the valve id whose turn starts it), level (the storey), cells (absolute [x, y] cells the water reaches) and optional steps (per cell, walkway steps from the pipe; default the cell index). The hunters path around its deep cells once the flow runs. Empty until a level authors one.
